status_summary: VA proposed on 2025-08-04 and finalized on 2025-12-31 a rule titled Reproductive Health Services (90 FR 61310, effective 2026-01-30). It restores the exclusion of abortion and abortion counseling from the medical benefits package and from CHAMPVA, reversing the 2022 interim final rule and the 2024 final rule. The final rule removes the rape, incest and health-endangerment exceptions; CHAMPVA keeps a life-of-the-mother exception, and VA states that care for life-threatening pregnancy complications remains covered. VA cites a 2025-12-18 Department of Justice Office of Legal Counsel opinion as its primary legal basis. Minority Veterans of America filed a petition for review in the Federal Circuit, reported by the Associated Press as filed on or about 2026-05-21, asking the court to set aside the rule; no stay or ruling was found as of 2026-10-14. Separately, on 2025-03-17 VA rescinded VHA Directive 1341(4) on gender dysphoria care, stopped offering cross-sex hormone therapy to new patients (veterans already receiving it from VA, or who received it from the military at separation, may continue), and stated that it has never offered sex-change surgery and will not provide other medical or surgical therapy for gender dysphoria.

timeline.event: VA announces it is rescinding VHA Directive 1341(4), ending cross-sex hormone therapy for new patients with gender dysphoria while allowing current recipients to continue, and states it has never offered sex-change surgery.
